text:
eve: heads-up — noticed a spike in unassigned inbound leads this morning (Salesforce didn't get owner). seeing a backlog in the handoff dashboard :eyes:

matt: saw that too. looks like the HubSpot workflow that writes owner -> SF is skipping when `region` is empty. round-robin step uses `region != ''` and short-circuits.

jordan: ugh. that explains leads falling into limbo. quick mitigation: set default region = 'global' before owner assignment. can we do that in the enrichment step?

matt: yep. quick patch idea: add a workflow action `Set property value` before the rotation action:
```
IF lead.region is empty
  THEN set lead.region = "global"

followed by existing Rotate in list: sales-rep-rotate-EMEA
```

alyssa: what about SLA? sales ops dashboard shows response SLA (first-touch) target = 15m. how many leads missed that?

matt: preliminary numbers: ~42 leads in last 3 hours missed 15m because no owner -> no webtask created in SF. will run full query and post numbers to the report.

revops-bot: automation-alert: HubSpot workflow `inbound-to-sf-v2` failed 8 times between 2026-03-21T07:00:00Z and 2026-03-21T09:12:00Z. Ticket created: #OPS-4312

eve: thanks @revops-bot. @jordan can you push the default-region change to the staging workflow and run a replay for the last 2 hours of leads? want to confirm owners are assigned end-to-end (HS -> SF).

jordan: on it. will: 1) patch staging workflow, 2) replay 2h backlog to staging, 3) sanity-check SF contact + task creation. expecting ~10 min.

alyssa: also can we add a fallback rule: if rotation action errors, send lead to `inbound-escalation` queue and ping `#sales-switchover`? avoids silent failures.

matt: good call. propose this minimal logic:
```
Action: Rotate owner by pool
OnFailure: Set owner = inbound-escalation-queue; Post slack to #sales-switchover with lead link
```

jordan: will include that in the patch. will also add a small logging action `set hs property: rr_status = attempted` to make debugging easier.

eve: one more: enrichment. we're missing company_size for ~30% of leads which affects routing rules. can we enqueue a Clearbit enrichment step before rotation? or at least mark `needs_enrichment = true` so revops pipeline can pick up?

matt: Clearbit call costs add up, but for now set `needs_enrichment = true` for leads missing company_size. we'll have a daily job that bulk-enriches. long-term: conditional enrichment (only for Tier A leads).

alyssa: after changes, update the inbound playbook (handoff section) and send a 1-paragraph note to sales ops + AMs. I'll handle the communication once fixes are verified.

jordan: deployed staging patch + fallback rule added. replay done for 2h sample — owners now set for test leads. moving to prod in 15m unless you object.

matt: good to go from my side. added OPS-4312 PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/PR-256 — includes workflow JSON diff and fallback slack action.

eve: deploy in 15. once prod is live, @matt please run the missed-SLA numbers and post updated count. then we'll update the playbook and notify sales.

revops-bot: prod-deploy: inbound-workflows v2 -> success (2026-03-21T09:40:00Z).

alyssa: confirmed — SF tasks are being created, `owner` populated, and first-touch tasks queued. initial SLA misses dropped from 42 -> 3 (edge cases). nice work team :tada:

eve: closing thread after playbook update. follow-ups: OPS-4312 (postmortem + add e2e test), backlog enrichment job ticket OPS-4321. thanks all! :sparkles:
